title: France investigates actor Depardieu, writer Houellebecq over alleged gang rape
summary: French police are investigating allegations actor and convicted sex offender Gérard Depardieu raped and assaulted a woman with the complicity of bestselling author Michel Houellebecq during a 2018 film shoot, two sources following the case said Friday. The plaintiff has accused the film's director Guillaume Nicloux of being complicit in the abuse.
